questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: An isolated physical system transitions from initial state parameter $p_i = 9$ to final configuration $p_f = 11$ while conserving the quantity $\mathcal{E} = p_i^2 + 2p_f$. What is the value of $\mathcal{E}$ in SI units?
questions.explanation: Apply the conservation & invariant balance principles in Gravitation (Orbital Velocity & Satellites).

questions.explanation: Apply the conservation & invariant balance principles in Gravitation (Escape Energy).

questions.subject: Physics

questions.explanation: Apply the instantaneous rate & gradient law principles in Gravitation (Gravitational Potential in Shells).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: When the amplitude of the driving excitation in a linear resistive medium (resistance $14$ units) is multiplied by $7$, by what factor does the rate of quadratic energy dissipation change?

questions.explanation: Apply the boundary ratio & scaling analysis principles in Gravitation (Escape Energy).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A physical quantity $f(z)$ increases linearly from $0$ to $30$ units over the interval $z \in [0, 8]$. Evaluate $\int_0^{8} f(z)\,dz$.
questions.solution: Area of the right triangle under the linear curve is $\frac{1}{2} \times 8 \times 30 = 120$.
questions.explanation: Apply the graphical slope & area integration principles in Gravitation (Gravitational Potential in Shells).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A linear calibration line has slope $16$ and vertical-axis intercept $-2$. At what value of the horizontal coordinate does the output cross zero?
questions.explanation: Apply the graphical slope & area integration principles in Gravitation (Kepler Laws).

questions.question: A physical observable $Z$ is related to independent measurements $A$ and $B$ by $Z = A^{3} B^{-2}$. If the relative error in $A$ is $1\%$ and in $B$ is $17\%$, what is the maximum percentage error in $Z$?
questions.explanation: Apply the dimensional & exponent homogeneity principles in Gravitation (Orbital Velocity & Satellites).

questions.subject: Physics

questions.explanation: Apply the dimensional & exponent homogeneity principles in Gravitation (Escape Energy).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: An interaction reduces the mechanical energy of a body to $\frac{1}{8}$ of its initial value $E_0 = 176\text{ J}$. How much mechanical energy is lost during the interaction?
questions.solution: Dissipated energy $\Delta E = E_0 - E_0/8 = 176 - 22 = 154\text{ J}$.
questions.explanation: Apply the energy efficiency & dissipation principles in Gravitation (Escape Energy).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: For a mechanical assembly to remain stable, the stiffness parameter $k$ must exceed the critical value $k_c = 23\text{ N/m}$. If the operating stiffness is set to $k = 48\text{ N/m}$, what is the excess stiffness margin $k - k_c$?
questions.solution: The stability margin is $k - k_c = (48) - 23 = 25\text{ N/m}$.
questions.explanation: Apply the critical threshold & equilibrium principles in Gravitation (Gravitational Potential in Shells).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Three coplanar forces keep a point mass in static equilibrium. If two of the forces are mutually perpendicular with magnitudes $24\text{ N}$ and $3\text{ N}$, what is the magnitude of the third force?
questions.explanation: Apply the critical threshold & equilibrium principles in Gravitation (Kepler Laws).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The frequency response function $H(\omega) = \frac{100}{\omega + 4^2 / \omega}$ for $\omega > 0$ reaches its maximum value at $\omega = \omega_0$. Determine $\omega_0$ and $H(\omega_0)$.
questions.solution: By AM-GM, $\omega + 4^2/\omega \ge 2(4)$ with equality at $\omega_0 = 4$, giving $H_{\max} = \frac{100}{2\cdot 4} = \frac{25}{2}$.
questions.explanation: Apply the resonance & extremum condition principles in Gravitation (Orbital Velocity & Satellites).
